text: The resolution refers to "occupied Palestinian territory including East Jerusalem." There is no such thing as "Palestinian territory" and never was. First of all, the term "Palestinian" is itself bogus. Palestinian identity was an artificial creation invented solely to destroy the Jewish entitlement to their own homeland. "Palestine" was invented by the Romans to rename Judea, in order to eradicate Jewish entitlement to land the Romans had conquered and to expunge all trace of its Jewish identity. Arabs who lived in pre-Israel Palestine were either nomadic or considered themselves Syria or pan-Arab. As many Arabs have acknowledged over the years, there is no such thing as a "Palestinian". Second, the land in dispute never belonged to the "Palestinians" nor indeed to any Arab state. Jordan illegally occupied Judea and Samaria, which it renamed the West Bank, between 1949 and 1967. That territory is in effect no-man's land. And given the terms of the British mandate which have never been overturned, it is only Israel which has any legal, moral or historical right to settle its people there.
